doc.value: the input text to be shown in the text field
doc.onValueChange: the callback that is triggered when the input service updates the text. An updated text comes as a parameter of the callback
doc.modifier: the [Modifier] to be applied to this text field
doc.enabled: controls the enabled state of this text field. When `false`, this component will not respond to user input, and it will appear visually disabled and disabled to accessibility services.
doc.readOnly: controls the editable state of the text field. When `true`, the text field cannot be modified. However, a user can focus it and copy text from it. Read-only text fields are usually used to display pre-filled forms that a user cannot edit.
doc.textStyle: the style to be applied to the input text. Defaults to [LocalTextStyle].
doc.label: the optional label to be displayed with this text field. The default text style uses [Typography.bodySmall] when minimized and [Typography.bodyLarge] when expanded.
doc.placeholder: the optional placeholder to be displayed when the text field is in focus and the input text is empty. The default text style for internal [Text] is [Typography.bodyLarge]
doc.leadingIcon: the optional leading icon to be displayed at the beginning of the text field container
doc.trailingIcon: the optional trailing icon to be displayed at the end of the text field container
doc.prefix: the optional prefix to be displayed before the input text in the text field
doc.suffix: the optional suffix to be displayed after the input text in the text field
doc.supportingText: the optional supporting text to be displayed below the text field
doc.isError: indicates if the text field's current value is in error. If set to true, the label, bottom indicator and trailing icon by default will be displayed in error color
doc.visualTransformation: transforms the visual representation of the input [value] For example, you can use [PasswordVisualTransformation][androidx.compose.ui.text.input.PasswordVisualTransformation] to create a password text field. By default, no visual transformation is applied.
doc.keyboardOptions: software keyboard options that contains configuration such as [KeyboardType] and [ImeAction].
doc.keyboardActions: when the input service emits an IME action, the corresponding callback is called. Note that this IME action may be different from what you specified in [KeyboardOptions.imeAction].
doc.singleLine: when `true`, this text field becomes a single horizontally scrolling text field instead of wrapping onto multiple lines. The keyboard will be informed to not show the return key as the [ImeAction]. Note that [maxLines] parameter will be ignored as the maxLines attribute will be automatically set to 1.
doc.maxLines: the maximum height in terms of maximum number of visible lines. It is required that 1 <= [minLines] <= [maxLines]. This parameter is ignored when [singleLine] is true.
doc.minLines: the minimum height in terms of minimum number of visible lines. It is required that 1 <= [minLines] <= [maxLines]. This parameter is ignored when [singleLine] is true.
doc.interactionSource: an optional hoisted [MutableInteractionSource] for observing and emitting [Interaction]s for this text field. You can use this to change the text field's appearance or preview the text field in different states. Note that if `null` is provided, interactions will still happen internally.
doc.shape: defines the shape of this text field's container
doc.colors: [TextFieldColors] that will be used to resolve the colors used for this text field in different states. See [TextFieldDefaults.colors].
